verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a desktop and server robotics simulator and set of C++ libraries, not a job-orchestration or automation platform, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows falls outside its product category. None of the evidence shows a built-in scheduler. Headless and CI-friendly server mode, CLI tools, and launch configuration scripts are adjacent features that could only be scheduled through external tools such as cron or CI, which is a user-side workaround and does not make the axis apply.
